notes.title: HotFix v1.2 - IMPROVING PERFORMANCE & BUILT IN POPULAR CONTROLLERS
notes.content:
HotFix v1.2

Bugs;


 Fixed the "Play Game" button not appearing for some players.
 Vairous bug fixes.


Performance;


 Improved the performance of AMD based graphics cards.
 Improved the overall performance of the game on low end PCs.
 Added DirectX12 launch version of the game.
 


Controller;


 Added easy to setup any controller and configure easily.
 Added more controller settings. (Steer Sensitivity, Throtle Sensitivity, Break Sensitivity etc.).
 Added popular controller support to the game. It is designed for you to use as plug and play.



Added Ready Controllers;


 Logitech G25
 Logitech G27
 Logitech G29
 Logitech G920
 Logitech Driving Force GT
 Logitech MOMO
 Thrustmaster FFB
 Thrustmaster T100
 Thrustmaster T150
 Thrustmaster T300 RS
 Thrustmaster T500 RS

notes.title: IMPROVING PERFORMANCE & BUILT IN POPULAR CONTROLLERS
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004875/3e6bca2d1ee493a09e6a81f2ddd8af2ca3cfd13d.png

First of all, thank you everyone for your valuable comments and suggestions !

We learned that some of our valuable players are experiencing some problems with the game. For us, our players and the enjoyment they get from our games are always at the forefront. And we took action immediately.

It will be published next week;

If you are experiencing performance problems, you can increase your performance by trying to change the graphics settings in the game. The game features NVidia DLSS 2.0 and AMD FXR 2.0. If your resolution is higher than 2k, you can try to use these technologies. But don't worry if none of this works. We produce solutions immediately.

Performance; 

 We are trying to improve the performance of AMD based graphics cards.
 We are trying to improve the overall performance of the game on low end PCs.
 We will add DirectX12 launch version of the game.


Some of you reported that they could not use or install the steering wheel or controller set they had in the game. There is a menu to set up most controllers you have in the game. However, we will redesign this menu and look for easy installation ways for you. We produce solutions immediately.

Controller;

 Easy to setup any controller and configure easily.
 More controller settings are being brought to the game. (Steer Sensitivity, Throtle Sensitivity etc.).
 We are bringing popular controller support to the game. It is designed for you to use as plug and play.


Coming Ready Controllers;
